Yes it's more convenient but I wonder if that's easy to understand. Actually I think that's not easy to understand at all because you trigger a tab on the right and it triggers a behavior also on the left so you would either know it's working like this or discover it by trying only (= luck).

What about a checkbox/button on the right of "widget display" in your screenshot that says "view underlying css classes" or "toggle css debug" "view class names"?
